description:
Hushfacebook v0.1.2 targets Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 (com.facebook.katana), and 577.0.0.50.72 still works.

This release adds JSON export and import for the switches in Hushfacebook settings. It previews changes before import, skips settings a build doesn't know, and refuses damaged or newer files without changing anything. Hushfacebook also has a new Facebook-blue icon, README hero, social preview and wordmarks.

13 patches in all. Sponsored and suggested posts leave the news feed without a gap, and ads are gone from Stories and Reels. Facebook stops downloading ads in the background and sending ad telemetry. Links open in your own browser, stories and reels can be saved, and there's an AMOLED black theme if you want one.

Validation: 274 runtime tests passed locally. All 79 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lint checks. All 13 patches applied to Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72 with no manifest changes.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 from APKMirror. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
